GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped just ok settled down worse Mid Field Two Wide 6-7 Lengths (700m), urged hard approaching Turn , Straightened Up right to the Outside trying to run on, Under Whip 200 no run on # couldn't run on
Slow Out 3.0 Lengths settled last 6 Lengths (800m), same for home, lost Further Ground latter stages, leader who completely messed up start, totoal forgive # blew start (3L)
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began very awkwardly, contacted the inside barrier partition and lost ground. Over-raced early.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well rails gate paired out duelling for the lead (700m), pushed along Turn , Straightened Up kicked Clear of pace rival, headed Inside 100 couldn't hold winner # sitting shot late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted pre-race after contacting gate. Began awkwardly. When quest re tactics early, Rdr advised instructed to lead and not restrain gelding as it has a breathing issue-added in hindsight, shouldn’t have pressured the gelding in the middles stages and allowed outside runner to lead, in an endeavour to give mount the chance to finish the race off better.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Ridden Along Straight To The Front Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear ran along same To The Turn Kept Running (t/t/1st) # solid eff. 53
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A pre-race veterinary examination of the gelding, which struck a gate leaving the enclosure, passed it fit to race.

Jumped Well from the Inside . Went Forward led x 2 Lengths @ 600m. railed Straightening Up , Joined by runner-up. Gradually Gave Ground after run peaked 200m # led/peaked 200m

Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by half a length, Held Together in front & led rail by 0.75 Lengths turning, joined Straightening Up and Headed at the 120m, Lost Ground from there. [Stewards: Fractious in gates prior to start. App. jockey could offer no excuse for the disappointing performance. Post-race vet exam revealed it to be lame in the off fore. Vet clearance required.] # weakened last bit
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Fractious in gates prior to start. Rdr could offer no excuse for the disappointing performance. A post-race vet exam revealed lameness in the off fore. Vet cert prior to next racing. Passed.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok soon going forward mustered speed to lead crossed & steadied almost a length Clear (800m), cornered with a good kick found 2 Lengths , challenged late overhauled # led/kicked/nailed

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Not Bustled Settled Down 7th Inside 5 Lengths Good Pace on, locked away nowhere to go until the 400 into 5th x 300m, 3rd x 100m, # Sound Effort
